embed.title: !profile
embed.description: Profiles are separate sets of tracking rules — say home, work and weekend. Each has its own areas and location. Switch between them yourself or on a schedule.

fields.name: See profiles
fields.value: `{{prefix}}profile` or `{{prefix}}profile list` — your profiles, with `*` marking the active one, plus each one's areas, location and schedule

fields.name: Create, switch, delete
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}profile add work` — create a profile. It starts with no tracking and a copy of your current areas and location. You stay on your current profile.
`{{prefix}}profile work` or `{{prefix}}profile 2` — switch to a profile by name or number (`{{prefix}}profile switch work` also works)
`{{prefix}}profile remove work` — delete a profile and its tracking (`{{prefix}}profile remove 2` by number). Profile 1 can't be deleted.

fields.name: Copy tracking
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}profile copyto work` — copy the active profile's tracking to "work". This **replaces** the tracking already on "work".
`{{prefix}}profile copyto 2 3` — copy to several profiles, by name or number
`{{prefix}}profile copyto all` — copy to every other profile

fields.name: Switch on a schedule
fields.value:
This sets the schedule of the profile you are on, replacing any earlier one. At each time you give, you are switched to this profile.
`{{prefix}}profile settime weekday08:00 weekend10:00`
`{{prefix}}profile settime mon9 fri17:30` — minutes are optional
`{{prefix}}profile settime 18:00` — with no day, it means every day
`{{prefix}}profile settime weekday9-17/2` — weekdays at 09:00, 11:00, 13:00, 15:00 and 17:00 (a range can't cross midnight)
Days: `mon` `tue` `wed` `thu` `fri` `sat` `sun`, `weekday`, `weekend`, `every` (or `everyday`).
`{{prefix}}profile cleartime` — remove this profile's schedule

Times use your location's timezone. The bottom of `{{prefix}}profile` shows which timezone that is.
